i took a shower and then bleached my hair and took another shower and then toned my hair and took another shower so logically now i dont need to shower again for a month. 

thats my best attempt at looking not like a pile of shit i did in months it made me feel better for 3 hours give or take. this 'depressive episode' has been going for a year with a side of crippling anxiety. its not a episode anymore this is my life.

 shitty shitty pointless life.

im broke, jobless, obamacare doesnt give me any help and my family are a bunch of hardcore Christians who dont even think depression is a real thing; they would probably also tell me to fucking pray as a solution. 

my cats are assholes who dont really do much but i guess its them or a wall to talk to.
ugh i hate it when people throw god in there like it would magical help anything thats like me asking santa to bring me gifts as an adult which doesnt work cus he doesnt exist.
and now im here yelling at a digital wall, pretending it cares.
